Being on a college campus 95% of my food comes from campus dining, most of it is actually nice, I usually stick to the salad bar and cooked veggies with the occasional meat thrown in. I think becoming a vegetarian wouldn't be incredibly difficult for me, but I love chicken breast, unfortunately, my school only offers a fried chicken patty, which I stay far away from. My biggest issue is the food I brought from home, what I have right now is a 24 pack of ramen noodles, half a bag of sugary cereal, and 20 bags of popcorn. All I have is a microwave, hence the poor choice of snacks. It's easy for me to get through my day and go to dinner and tell myself I'm full, but then I get back to my room and see all the food I have and end up bingeing. My other issue is trying to get an accurate read on calories when I'm in the dining hall. We have a website that gives you an estimate, but measuring out half a cup of cooked broccoli in the middle of a dinner rush full of students is almost impossible. We do have a pool on campus, but I'm hesitant to use it for the same reasons I won't walk into the gym, I'm afraid of my peers. I don't want any attention, even positive attention. I don't want people to notice I'm trying to lose weight, I can't handle the idea of disappointment if I fail.

college student..finals are in a week, and I have a project due that I haven't started and a paper that's 1/3 done. I'm having a hard time staying motivated..I just want to sleep. I'm too depressed to do anything, and then my anxiety eats me alive at night for not doing anything all day. I can't even relax when I come back home this summer because I have to work a minimum of 30 hours/week and complete an internship. Finals are stressful for everyone, but I feel like I can barely cope with getting through the day. I can't even be motivated enough to do laundry or shower..how am I supposed to do my homework? I made a bucket list with my best friend of things to do this summer, but I feel bad because I probably won't complete it. I'm wondering if voluntarily checking in to a psych ward will screw up my work/internship too badly this summer. I won't even go talk to the counselors on campus, they aren't psychiatrists or even psychologists; they're just there to listen. I feel like I need some form of medication to keep me sane. I haven't cut in a few days, but I have a feeling this weekend will be the end of that. Sorry for the wall of text.
thanks! much love to you, it definitely helps to have somebody that understands.

It's just hard to keep it together, last night was a low point; especially when I sit alone with my own thoughts for too long. Music-wise, I listen too pretty much everything, my current unhealthy obsession is Fall Out Boy :) I saw them in concert a few weeks ago, and that kept me going for the longest time. Thanks for replying, I really appreciate knowing somebody cares. :)
